answer: The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The sparrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the jetty of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing.
